text: This annex consists of three parts. Part A of this annex describes the baseline for threats, vulnerabilities and attack methods. Part B of this annex describes mitigations to the threats which are intended for vehicle types. Part C describes mitigations to the threats which are intended for areas outside of vehicles, e.g. on IT backends.
source_document: E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3/Add.154 (4 March 2021) - UN Regulation No. 155; PDF: KB 2/UNECE WP.29 & UN Regulation No. 155 & 156.pdf

text: Part A, Part B, and Part C shall be considered for risk assessment and mitigations to be implemented by vehicle manufacturers.
source_document: E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3/Add.154 (4 March 2021) - UN Regulation No. 155; PDF: KB 2/UNECE WP.29 & UN Regulation No. 155 & 156.pdf

text: The high-level vulnerability and its corresponding examples have been indexed in Part A. The same indexing has been referenced in the tables in Parts B and C to link each of the attack/vulnerability with a list of corresponding mitigation measures.
source_document: E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3/Add.154 (4 March 2021) - UN Regulation No. 155; PDF: KB 2/UNECE WP.29 & UN Regulation No. 155 & 156.pdf
